messages:
anya: Quick sync on compact playground token UX — badge keeps jumping during streaming and hides actions. Thoughts?

mike: Pin to the message bubble. Keep it small + subtle. Avoid moving rail.

dani: Agree. Make hit area >=24px for touch. Add keyboard focus and aria-label.

sanjay: aria suggestion: 'Tokens used 96 of 2048'. Use role=button so it opens details. Also add live-region messages when stream stops.

mike: Button text: 'Stop' vs 'Interrupt' vs 'Pause'? Prefer 'Stop' with tooltip 'Stop (interrupt generation)'.

dani: For regenerate CTA use 'Try again' primary, 'Regenerate' in microcopy for advanced users. Focus should move to action group after stop.

anya: Animation idea: fade + tiny slide instead of jumping (.12s transitions). Also show cached state toast after interrupt: 'Cached: quick regenerate available'.

sanjay: I'll add accessibility checklist and telemetry events (tokenBadgeShown, stopPressed, regeneratePressed, a11yAnnounced).

aria-bot: Created experiment ticket PL-5090 with variants: bubble_badge, rail_badge. Rollout 0.05.

anya: Dani make figma frames for copy variants + focus flow. Mike will prototype CSS. Follow up in two days. :thumbsup:
